claims.claim: Clean and powerful Trailer Head Engine, in excellent condition and ready for work.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show DAF 24-valve engine components/valve covers, but do not show running/starting, leak/compression tests, or clear condition indicators.
No evidence of performance tests (start video, smoke test, compression/leak test) in the witness report.

risks.risk: Engine may be incomplete or missing key parts (ECU, starter, alternator, injectors, sensors), since the engine appears partially disassembled and not all accessories are shown.
risks.proof: A full laid-out parts checklist photo/video showing every included component (ECU, starter, alternator, turbo, injectors, sensors) with labels, plus a photo of the engine fully assembled/complete.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as engine-only/possibly incomplete and not guaranteed ready-for-work.

risks.risk: Not confirmed working condition (may have internal issues like low compression, leaks, or seized turbo).
risks.proof: Short start/run video (cold start if possible) showing stable idle, no abnormal knocking, and no heavy smoke, plus a compression/leak test sheet if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Hidden damage not visible in the provided angles (cracks, bent rods, damaged mounts, wiring harness issues).
risks.proof: Close-ups of critical areas: cylinder head/valve cover surfaces for cracks, turbo condition, oil/coolant passages, and engine mounts; plus underside/side views.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with allowance for possible damage beyond what’s visible.

risks.risk: Unclear exact engine variant/engine code beyond 'DAF 24 valve'—compatibility risk for the buyer’s trailer head setup.
risks.proof: Photo of the engine ID/engine code plate and stamped numbers (engine block/side) and confirmation of exact series/variant.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest compatible assumption (may require matching/parts swap).

risks.risk: Documentation/traceability risk (VIN/engine number match, receipts) and return/warranty terms unknown.
risks.proof: Photos of documentation: engine number/VIN match, receipts, and any warranty/return policy in writing.

proof_requests: Send a video of the engine starting and running (idle + brief rev), showing no abnormal smoke/knocking.
Provide compression/leak test results (or a mechanic’s test report) and photos of the test setup.
Show a complete parts inventory photo/video: ECU, starter, alternator, injectors, turbo, sensors, wiring harness, hoses—confirm what is included.
Provide close-ups of engine ID/engine code plate and stamped numbers for exact variant.
Share documentation: receipts and any engine number/VIN match, plus return/warranty terms.
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s a DAF 24-valve truck engine, but the photos do not prove it’s complete or working (no start/run or test evidence). Without that, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
